design_philosophy: Energetic Civic Neo-Brutalism. Combines the approachability and youthfulness of Vibrant Play with the structured authority and clarity of Swiss High-Contrast. It uses bold geometric shapes, vivid colors against stark white, and hard drop shadows to signify action and opportunity in Halifax.

primary.name: Beacon Yellow
primary.usage: Primary action buttons, prominent highlights, energetic accents.

secondary.name: Halifax Ocean Blue
secondary.usage: Secondary CTAs, major section backgrounds, trustworthy brand anchoring.

accent.name: Signal Red
accent.usage: Alerts, urgent deadlines for job postings, energetic badges.

background.name: Stark White
background.usage: Main application background for maximum contrast.

border.name: Hard Black
border.usage: 2px solid borders for all cards, inputs, and buttons.

headings.usage: All major headers (H1, H2, H3). Do not use Inter or generic sans. Keep headings large but max out at text-6xl.

layout_spacing.container: Max-width screen-xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Use generous spacing. Default section gaps should be py-16 or py-24.
layout_spacing.grid_system: Mode A: 'Tetris' Grid for Marketing (asymmetric, bento-style). Mode B: 'Control Room' Grid for User Dashboard and Job Board (dense, data-focused but maintaining thick borders).
layout_spacing.borders_and_shadows: Neo-Brutalist style. Use 2px solid black borders (border-2 border-black) and hard shadows (shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)]) for cards and buttons. On hover, translate buttons and cards to simulate pressing down (translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)]).

cards.style: Solid background (white, yellow, or blue), 2px solid black border, hard offset shadow. No rounded corners (rounded-none) or very slight (rounded-sm). Internal padding p-6 or p-8.

buttons.primary: bg-[#FFD100] text-black border-2 border-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide px-6 py-3 shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:translate-y-[2px] hover:translate-x-[2px] hover:shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)] transition-all
buttons.secondary: bg-[#0055A4] text-white border-2 border-black font-bold px-6 py-3 shadow-[4px_4px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)] hover:bg-[#004080] transition-all

inputs.style: bg-white border-2 border-black p-3 focus:ring-0 focus:outline-none focus:bg-[#F4F4F4] transition-colors

navigation.style: Solid white background, strict bottom border (border-b-2 border-black). Sticky positioning. High contrast links.

badges.style: bg-white border-2 border-black px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase inline-block shadow-[2px_2px_0_0_rgba(0,0,0,1)]

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Do NOT use TypeScript (.tsx). Use ONLY .js and .jsx extensions for all React components.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Rely exclusively on the URLs provided in the media section of this JSON.
The UI is 'Neo-Brutalist'. This means: hard shadows, thick borders (2px), no rounded corners, and very high contrast. It is not a soft corporate SaaS.
For hover states on cards and buttons, simulate the 'press' effect: translate down and right, and reduce the shadow to 0.
Use Bricolage Grotesk or Cabinet Grotesk for Headings. If not available in standard Google Fonts, fallback to Syne or Epilogue. Add the import in index.css.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='job-apply-button').
Use Tailwind CSS for styling. Use generic Shadcn UI components as a base but heavily override them with border-black border-2, rounded-none, and hard shadows.
Ensure there is a visible navigation bar on desktop, and a distinct footer.
When applying images, avoid dark overlay blankets; use gradient overlays or bento-box layouts where text sits outside the image.
